subject: Clarifying technical qualification & evidence requests — ClearHarbor
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@clearharbor.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Clarifying technical qualification & evidence requests — ClearHarbor

Hi Samir / Lena —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and the concrete next steps we agreed so your security team has everything in one place. Please reply with any corrections.

High-level pain & goals you shared
- Audit log retention: need immutable audit logging for admin actions and tokenized request logs retained for 13 months for compliance.
- SOC 2 readiness: you are mid-way through readiness; interested in artifacts we can provide to accelerate acceptance.
- Pen test evidence: you need recent pen-test report and remediation notes or an attestation.
- DPA + contractual terms: standard vendor DPA plus explicit retention/erasure clauses and a right-to-audit window.

What Redwood will provide (items we discussed)
1) SOC 2 one-pager and scope summary (attached: SOC2-summary-2026-09.pdf).
2) Audit log sample + schema description (attached: log-sample-20260928.zip) — includes example events and field mapping.
3) DPA draft for your legal review (attached: DPA-draft-ClearHarbor.docx).
4) Pen-test attestation + high-level remediation summary (pending internal sign-off; estimate by 2026-10-06).

Immediate asks from ClearHarbor (what we need from you)
- Confirm retention window: 13 months is the target — confirm whether backups/archival need separate SLAs.
- Provide your SOC 2 scope expectations (in-scope systems/processes) so we can map overlap.
- Let us know if you require on-prem evidence transfer (SFTP) or if a secure Drive link is sufficient.

Next steps & owners
- Marissa: upload SOC 2 one-pager + log sample to shared drive (done, link below).
- Neha (Security): will follow up with specific artifact list and timelines for evidence delivery by 2026-10-06.
- Samir / Lena: confirm DPA comments and retention confirmation by 2026-10-07 so we can route to legal.
- Schedule: propose a 30-min follow-up for Tuesday 2026-10-06 to review evidence mapping.

Attachments: SOC2-summary-2026-09.pdf, log-sample-20260928.zip, DPA-draft-ClearHarbor.docx

Shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cClearHarborEvidence
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/CLH-3721

Thanks — speak soon.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0193

From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@clearharbor.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@clearharbor.com>, security@clearharbor.com, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarifying technical qualification & evidence requests — ClearHarbor

Marissa —

Appreciate the concise summary. A couple clarifications from our side:

- Retention: 13 months is correct for primary logs. For backups we can accept the same retention but would like an SLA that includes time-to-provide if we request a historical export (48 hours preferred).
- On pen test: we asked for the most recent external pen-test report (not earlier than 2025) plus a remediation tracker. If you can provide an attestation in the meantime that would help the internal reviewers.
- Evidence transfer: secure Drive link is fine for now, but our InfoSec lead prefers SFTP for any transfer of raw log archives. If Redwood can provide SFTP credentials, that would be ideal.

We can review the DPA; Lena will add legal comments next week.

Let's tentatively take the follow-up on Tuesday 2026-10-06 at 10:00 PT. If that works for your team we can send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Samir
Director, Vendor Risk — ClearHarbor Financial
samir.khan@clearharbor.com | +1 617-555-2378

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@clearharbor.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarifying technical qualification & evidence requests — ClearHarbor

Hi Samir / Lena —

Thanks — welcome clarifications. A quick note from Redwood Security on what we can provide and timelines:

Requested artifacts and delivery plan
- SOC 2 scope & mapping doc: final by 2026-10-06 EOD (PDF).
- Pen-test attestation + remediation summary: internal sign-off in progress; attestation + tracker by 2026-10-06; full report available (redacted) by 2026-10-08 pending partner NDA.
- Raw log archive (sample/truncated): we can make an export available via SFTP. Please provide an SFTP target or we can provision temporary credentials to a locked bucket and provide a signed URL. ETA: 2026-10-07.
- Audit log schema & query examples: included in the SOC 2 mapping doc.

Regarding retention SLAs: Redwood's default is 30 days hot retention + archival for requested export up to configured retention (we support up to 13 months archival). We can commit to 48-hour turnaround on export requests for the CLH contract; we will capture this in the DPA addendum.

Open items for your legal/security teams
- Confirm whether you need a right-to-audit window beyond standard vendor audits.
- Confirm whether encryption-at-rest metadata fields are sufficient or if you require field-level encryption for specific PII fields.

I'll attach the SOC 2 mapping doc to the follow-up email once finalized.

—
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Clarifying technical qualification & evidence requests — ClearHarbor

Thanks all —

Per Neha and our internal owners:
- We will provision SFTP credentials by 2026-10-07 to deliver the requested log-sample archive.
- Pen-test attestation + remediation tracker targeted for 2026-10-06; redacted report by 2026-10-08.
- DPA: Marissa to collect initial comments by 2026-10-07 and route to Legal for turnaround.

I scheduled the 30-min follow-up for Tue 2026-10-06 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent). Agenda: evidence mapping, SFTP details, and DPA comment alignment.

DocuSign link for the draft DPA (for initial acceptance before legal redlines): https://www.docusign.com/link/to/DPA-CLH-3721

If anything else pops up before the call, flag directly on this thread and we'll triage. Looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
